spans.text: ...After a long time, everything fades into silence and confusion.
There's should be auxiliary power supplies in a warehouse somewhere!
Surely the Military wouldn't take those, right? That means they're definitely in there.
Yep! Let's go look for a Griffin warehouse!
Let's check the map, there's got to be a supply point around here somewhere...
Hah! There a resupply point just opposite, and there ought to be a backup power supply in there!
Who knows, some Griffin T-Dolls may still be around, and while I don't know how I should greet them, it should be okay as long as we're all on the same side!
But there's so many S.F. units around...
I mustn't be rash. I've got to learn from M4A1 and the others and think of a cautious plan...
Do my best to avoid their big groups, and if anyone spots me, I have to destroy them right away.
Yep! I've covered all the possibilities! There are no loopholes. It's perfect! Let's do it.
Come on, RO! We'll be able to wake you up soon!
